classifications.LEGITIMATE_SCIENTIFIC_STOP: NO_REPAIR_SIGNAL, NO_ACTIONABLE_PATTERN, NO_SAFE_EDIT, NO_COMMIT, SHADOW_REJECT; saturation uses unchanged Team Epoch rules.
classifications.RECOVERABLE_PER_CANDIDATE: Layer1 invalid structure, block, duplicate, dependency guard or NO_SAFE_EDIT retains previous pool; Probe rejection retains other candidates.
classifications.RECOVERABLE_PER_DRAW: Typed Gradient/whole Cluster output rejection or Reflection truncation within frozen draw/generation bounds.
classifications.RECOVERABLE_PER_EXAMPLE: Solver bounded semantic draws; terminal-invalid scores incorrect. Gradient exhaustion preserves other examples.
classifications.RECOVERABLE_PER_PATTERN: Known valid supports of rejected content move to unassigned; ID or provenance faults stay fatal.

limitations: Dynamic Python and third-party exceptions are not enumerated exhaustively; all unmatched errors propagate fatally.
